ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dividends_paid.basis: never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements) + buybacks (1/4 quarters filed (2025-12-31) — a lower bound) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buyback_yield.note: a lower bound — a positive leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

net_buyback_yield.note: a lower bound — a positive leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

legs.dividends_paid: never filed in any period — zero by the filer's own statements

shareholder_yield.note: a lower bound — a positive leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

dividend_yield.label: —
dividend_yield.note: no dividends-per-share facts filed (CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared / CashPaid or IFRS equivalents) and no dividends paid — not a dividend payer

buyback_yield.label: ≥ 0.00%
buyback_yield.note: buybacks: 1/4 quarters filed (2025-12-31) — understated, so this yield is a lower bound

net_buyback_yield.label: ≥ -0.17%
net_buyback_yield.note: buybacks: 1/4 quarters filed (2025-12-31) — understated, so this yield is a lower bound

shareholder_yield.label: ≥ -0.17%
shareholder_yield.note: buybacks: 1/4 quarters filed (2025-12-31) — understated, so this yield is a lower bound

notes: buybacks: quarters left out (not a sign error) — quarter ended 2024-12-31: the year-to-date facts decrease (2024-01-01..2024-09-30 = 100,388,000 > 2024-01-01..2024-12-31 = 100,387,000) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -1,000; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter)
no dividends-per-share facts filed (CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared / CashPaid or IFRS equivalents) and no dividends paid — not a dividend payer
